events.summary: ExxonMobil Global Projects has awarded Sercel a one-year contract to deploy its Marlin software solution for the Whiptail project in the Stabroek Block, offshore Guyana. events.summary: Eni SpA has approved the final investment decision for the Cronos deepwater gas field offshore Cyprus, marking the nation's first hydrocarbon project. This project is expected to contribute significantly to both Eni's and TotalEnergies' LNG portfolio targets, positioning Cyprus as a key player in the Eastern Mediterranean gas strategy.

events.summary: The article discusses the continued strong performance of commodities, highlighting the ALPS CoreCommodity Natural Resources ETF (CCNR) as a practical investment vehicle. events.summary: ConocoPhillips is anticipated to announce strong second-quarter earnings, with analysts expecting significant sequential profit growth despite recent drops in crude oil prices. events.title: EOG Resources Inc Stock (EOG) Moved Down by 5.81% on Aug 5: A Full Analysis
events.summary: EOG Resources Inc (EOG) stock dropped by 5.81% on August 5th due to missing quarterly earnings expectations, higher operational costs, and a downward revision in full-year production guidance. Broader macroeconomic headwinds, including declining crude oil prices and cooling global industrial demand, exacerbated the sell-off in the energy sector. events.title: Equinor, Vaalco and Tullow move Atlantic Basin offshore drilling programs forward
events.summary: Equinor, Vaalco Energy, and Tullow Oil are actively progressing their offshore drilling initiatives across the Atlantic Basin. Equinor has resumed operations at the Rosebank development west of Shetland after a significant rig incident, while Vaalco is advancing its Etame drilling campaign offshore Gabon with a new gas-supply well and plans for further development. Tullow Oil is preparing for its next drilling phase at the Jubilee and TEN fields offshore Ghana, targeting operations for the second half of 2027 based on advanced seismic data.

events.title: Analysts say oil profit critics don't understand how market works
events.summary: Oil companies, including Exxon Mobil and Chevron, reported significant profit increases in the second quarter due to rising oil prices driven by the conflict with Iran. Analysts argue that these profits are a result of basic market dynamics, specifically supply and demand influenced by geopolitical events, rather than corporate manipulation. They emphasize that such earnings are crucial for investment in production and ultimately for stabilizing prices for consumers.

events.title: Regulators could vote Thursday on OG&E battery energy storage system project
events.summary: Oklahoma regulators are set to vote on Thursday on a proposed $394 million Frontier Energy Storage Project by Oklahoma Gas and Electric (OG&E). This battery energy storage system (BESS) is one of several projects aimed at increasing electricity generation to meet rising power demands, with OG&E stating a significant need for additional generation capacity through 2031. The project, located in Kay County, Oklahoma, is expected to be commercially operational by late 2027.

events.title: Shale producer Occidental Petroleum beats quarterly profit estimates
events.summary: Occidental Petroleum reported its highest quarterly profit since 2022, exceeding Wall Street expectations, driven by higher oil prices and increased production. events.title: Phillips 66 Profit Jumps as Refining Margins More Than Double
events.summary: Phillips 66 announced a significant surge in second-quarter 2026 earnings, reaching $3.85 billion, primarily driven by its refining business where adjusted pre-tax income rose to $3.09 billion and realized refining margins more than doubled. The company also saw improvements in Marketing and Specialties, Renewable Fuels, and Midstream segments, while reducing its total debt by $6.6 billion.

events.title: Occidental Quarterly Profit Soars to Highest Since 2022 on Oil Rally
events.summary: Occidental Petroleum reported its highest quarterly profit since 2022, exceeding Wall Street expectations, driven by higher oil prices and increased production. This strong performance mirrors that of larger rivals like Chevron and ExxonMobil, benefiting from the surge in oil prices amidst Middle East tensions.

events.title: Krishnamoorthi Presses BP, Chevron, Exxon Mobil, and Shell to Reduce Carbon Emissions, Citing Evidence Linking Fossil Fuel Emissions to More Severe Wildfires
events.summary: Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi has urged major oil companies BP, Chevron, Exxon Mobil, and Shell to take immediate action to reduce carbon emissions. He cites growing scientific evidence linking fossil fuel emissions to increasingly severe wildfires, which have led to hazardous air quality in cities like Chicago. Krishnamoorthi emphasizes that the industry must acknowledge its role and take responsibility for exacerbating these climate-driven fires.

events.title: Gran Tierra expects about $250M cash and zero debt at closing
events.summary: Gran Tierra Energy has agreed to sell its Colombia and Ecuador oil assets to Maurel & Prom for a total enterprise value of $1.33 billion. The company anticipates receiving approximately $315 million in net cash proceeds, with $250 million at closing and an additional $65 million via a note due in 364 days. Following the transaction, Gran Tierra expects to be debt-free, retain an undrawn CAD $75 million credit facility, and focus its operations on Canada and exploration in Azerbaijan.

events.title: Par Pacific Holdings (NYSE: PARR) posts $462M Q2 profit on refining strength
events.summary: Par Pacific Holdings (NYSE: PARR) reported a significant surge in its Q2 2026 profits, reaching $462.1 million (diluted EPS $9.35) compared to $59.5 million (EPS $1.17) in Q2 2025. This strong performance was primarily driven by higher refining segment margins, normalized operations at its Wyoming refinery, and increased crude and product prices. For the first half of 2026, the company's revenue hit $4.79 billion and net income attributable to stockholders was $516.6 million, with Adjusted EBITDA reaching $662.8 million.

events.title: Lawsuit seeks fossil fuel-free 401(k) plan on religious grounds
events.summary: A scientist in New York is suing Thermo Fisher Scientific for refusing his request for a fossil fuel-free 401(k) plan, citing his Christian beliefs about environmental stewardship. The lawsuit, filed on religious grounds, aims to test the extent to which companies must honor religious accommodations, especially after a 2023 Supreme Court decision setting a "substantial costs" standard for denial. If successful, the case could pave the way for millions to access retirement options aligned with their religious or moral convictions, including on climate change.

events.title: Oil Prices Are Back In Focus With 3 Energy Stocks Worth A Closer Look
events.summary: The article highlights how recent Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries have brought energy security and oil prices back into focus, impacting oil and gas producers. It details three energy stocks—Magnolia Oil & Gas (MGY), Tamarack Valley Energy (TVE), and Green Plains (GPRE)—that could be positively affected by elevated crude prices. The piece discusses each company's operations, financial performance, and specific market exposures, offering insights into their potential upside and associated risks for investors.

events.title: ExxonMobil Corporation (NYSE:XOM) Receives Consensus Recommendation of "Hold" from Analysts
events.summary: ExxonMobil Corporation (NYSE:XOM) has received a consensus "Hold" rating from analysts, with an average 12-month price target of $162.95, indicating modest upside from its current share price of $151.53. Despite exceeding revenue expectations and seeing sharp year-over-year earnings growth in Q2, the company narrowly missed EPS estimates. Positive factors include strong production, high oil prices, and robust refining margins, while potential political pressure over gasoline prices and mixed analyst sentiment present some challenges.

events.title: Canadian Natural marks 26 straight years of dividend increases
events.summary: Canadian Natural Resources Limited has declared a quarterly cash dividend of C$0.625 per common share, payable on October 2, 2026. The consistent dividend growth reflects the company's confidence in its sustainable business model, strong balance sheet, and diverse asset base.

events.title: The geopolitical case for geothermal as a domestic energy resource
events.summary: Geothermal energy is gaining recognition as a critical domestic resource that can help countries achieve energy security, affordability, and decarbonization goals. Despite its potential, high drilling costs and early-stage resource uncertainty hinder investment, necessitating government support through risk-sharing, streamlined permitting, and favorable revenue frameworks. By addressing these challenges, geothermal can significantly contribute to the global energy transition, complementing other energy sources like natural gas, nuclear, and renewables.

events.title: South Bow on track for mid-2027 decision on Prairie Connector investment
events.summary: South Bow Corp. is aiming for a final investment decision on its Prairie Connector project by mid-2027, having secured 20-year commitments from nine shippers for 465,000 barrels per day. The project, which would transport oilsands crude to the Canada-U.S. border, could utilize dormant pipe from the defunct Keystone XL expansion. The company announced this progress during its Q2 earnings call, where it reported a net income of US$134 million, up from US$96 million a year earlier, with revenue reaching US$546 million.

events.title: ExxonMobil Corporation $XOM is Sanders Morris Harris LLC's 5th Largest Position

events.title: Cheniere Energy reports rise in second-quarter profit on increased LNG demand
events.summary: Cheniere Energy reported a significant increase in its second-quarter profit, driven by the surging demand for liquefied natural gas (LNG). The company's LNG revenue rose to $5.64 billion, contributing to a net income of $3.07 billion for the quarter. This positive performance comes as the U.S. solidifies its position as the world's largest LNG exporter, further bolstered by the recent lifting of a moratorium on new LNG export permits.

events.summary: Cheniere Energy raised its annual core profit outlook due to robust demand for liquefied natural gas, causing its shares to rise 4%. This strong performance underscores the U.S.'s position as the world's largest LNG exporter.

events.title: Wall Street Is Bullish on Chevron Stock. Here’s Our Price Target
events.summary: Chevron stock has seen a 31% year-to-date increase, with a 24/7 Wall St. price target of $204.72, implying a modest 5% upside and a "hold" rating due to its current valuation. While Chevron's operational execution is strong, the recent surge in its stock price leaves limited upside, suggesting a more attractive entry point around $180.

events.title: TravelCenters of America under scrutiny as BP continues portfolio review
events.summary: BP's new CEO, Meg O'Neill, has outlined five priorities for the company, including strengthening its balance sheet and simplifying its portfolio, leading to a critical review of TravelCenters of America (TA). BP plans to sell its Archaea Energy business and improve TA's financials, signaling that all company operations must generate cash and improve returns. This follows recent divestitures and layoffs, indicating a new era where even recently acquired businesses like TA, purchased for $1.3 billion in 2023, must prove their worth through data-driven performance.

events.title: Greenfire Resources Posts Q2 2026 Results and Expands Oil Sands Portfolio with Connacher Acquisition
events.summary: Greenfire Resources reported mixed Q2 2026 results, with bitumen production down due to planned maintenance but net income up to $53.5 million, helped by stronger crude prices. The company also significantly expanded its oil sands portfolio by acquiring Connacher Oil and Gas Limited, financed by a $1.0 billion credit facility and a $575 million bridge facility. Despite a strong balance sheet, Spark, TipRanks’ AI Analyst, rates GFR as Neutral due to negative free cash flow and revenue/earnings volatility.

events.title: Suncor CEO Rich Kruger stepping down in 2027
events.summary: Rich Kruger, CEO of Suncor Energy Inc. since 2023, will step down in April 2027 to become executive vice-chair. Peter Zebedee, currently executive vice-president upstream, will succeed him as CEO. Kruger was brought in to address safety issues and production targets, and has been credited with significantly improving safety records and financial performance during his tenure.

events.title: Upstream Earnings: ConocoPhillips’ Impact on ETF Market
events.summary: ConocoPhillips reported strong second-quarter earnings, beating consensus estimates, driven by elevated oil prices. The company's operational resilience and increased shareholder distributions highlight its fundamental strength within the industry.

events.summary: CF Industries Holdings, Inc. (CF) reported strong Q2 2026 earnings, with adjusted EBITDA of $2.2 billion for the first half, driven by operational performance and tight global nitrogen supply. The company updated its mid-cycle EBITDA expectations to $2.9 billion and free cash flow to $1.7 billion, citing higher capital costs for new nitrogen capacity. CF Industries is also progressing on strategic initiatives like the Blue Point project and expanding its low-carbon ammonia sales, while continuing aggressive share repurchases due to perceived undervaluation.

events.title: Exxon Links New $80 Billion Kazakh Oil Venture to Ending Dispute
events.summary: Exxon Mobil is linking a new $80 billion oil venture in Kazakhstan to resolving an ongoing dispute. This strategic move by Exxon suggests a significant step towards both new energy development and conflict resolution in the region.

events.title: Occidental Slashes $1.9 Billion in Debt as Oil Rally Drives Profit to Four-Year High
events.summary: Occidental Petroleum reported its highest quarterly profit since 2022, with adjusted earnings of $2.40 per share and revenue of $8.32 billion, exceeding Wall Street estimates. The company used $3 billion in free cash flow to retire $1.9 billion in debt, bringing its principal down to $11.8 billion, and raised its dividend by 8%. Production exceeded guidance, and realized crude prices jumped, contributing to a strong financial performance driven by elevated oil prices and geopolitical factors.

events.title: Phillips 66 Profit Soars
events.summary: Phillips 66 reported a significant increase in net income for Q2, reaching $3.85 billion, primarily driven by improved refining margins, higher plant utilization, and increased natural gas liquids pipeline and fractionation volumes. The company saw substantial growth across its refining, marketing and specialties, midstream, chemicals, and renewable fuels segments, dramatically reversing previous losses or modest profits. This strong performance led to an adjusted earnings per diluted share of $9.41, surpassing analyst projections.

events.title: Petrobras posts third-highest profit as Middle East conflict lifts oil prices
events.summary: Brazil's state-run oil firm Petrobras reported a 96% rise in second-quarter net profit to 52.4 billion reais, its third-highest ever, driven by surging oil prices due to the U.S.-Iran conflict. Despite beating market expectations, the company's earnings were negatively affected by government decisions to keep fuel prices low and export taxes, though it increased investments by almost 20% primarily in exploration and production.

events.title: ARKO Petroleum deal would add 400-plus dealer locations, ~$30M adjusted EBITDA
events.summary: ARKO Petroleum Corp. reported increased net income and Adjusted EBITDA in Q2 2026, reaching $12.2 million and $39.8 million respectively. ARKO Petroleum reaffirmed its full-year 2026 guidance and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.50 per share.

events.title: [10-Q] CF Industries Holdings, Inc. Quarterly Earnings Report
events.summary: CF Industries Holdings, Inc. (CF) reported significant increases in net earnings for both the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, driven by higher average selling prices for nitrogen products and insurance recoveries, despite lower sales volumes. The company's strategy focuses on decarbonizing its ammonia production network, with ongoing projects at Donaldsonville and the new Blue Point One joint venture, which is constructing a low-carbon ammonia facility. Geopolitical events and their impact on global supply and demand dynamics continued to influence nitrogen selling prices and market conditions.

events.title: Exxon nears peak impunity on climate obligations
events.summary: ExxonMobil is challenging the EU's new carbon storage rules despite being a major proponent of carbon capture technology and having significant financial resources. The company is using investor protection treaties to sue the EU, potentially seeking subsidies or a delay, highlighting how lawsuits may become a method for fossil fuel companies to offset energy transition costs.

events.title: ExxonMobil books McDermott for Mozambique’s multibillion-dollar LNG project
events.summary: McDermott Energy Solutions (UK) has secured a letter of intent from ExxonMobil Moçambique for the Rovuma LNG Phase 1 midstream development in Mozambique. The project, estimated at around $30 billion, aims to establish Mozambique as a major global LNG supplier, with a final investment decision expected in 2026 and startup anticipated in 2031. The initiative is projected to generate substantial revenues for Mozambique and create over 150,000 jobs.

events.title: What Imperial Oil (TSX:IMO)'s Q2 Earnings Beat and Board Shift Means For Shareholders
events.summary: Imperial Oil recently reported strong Q2 2026 earnings with CA$16,062 million in sales and CA$2,190 million in net income, alongside a maintained quarterly dividend and a new board member from ExxonMobil. This performance, despite slightly lower production, reinforces the company's focus on capital discipline and refinery reliability. However, investors are cautioned to consider the potential impact of tightening carbon regulations on Imperial Oil's long-term oil sands projects.

events.title: Vessel upgrade on the agenda: SLB, Equinor strike multi-year deal to unlock Norway's tight offshore reservoirs
events.summary: SLB and Equinor have signed a multi-year agreement for advanced reservoir stimulation services on the Norwegian Continental Shelf. This deal includes a major upgrade to the MV Island Captain well stimulation vessel, enhancing its capacity for tight offshore reservoirs. The upgraded vessel will be able to carry up to 2 million pounds of proppant, supporting the development of next-generation tight-reservoir projects in Norway.

events.title: SLB, Equinor to Upgrade Vessel Under Multi-Year Well Stimulation Deal
events.summary: SLB and Equinor have signed a multi-year agreement to provide advanced reservoir stimulation services on the Norwegian Continental Shelf. The deal includes a significant upgrade of the MV Island Captain well stimulation vessel, which will be converted to a fully proppant-capable vessel with expanded storage and increased pumping capacity. This upgrade aims to support the development of tight offshore reservoirs and maximize recovery from future wells in the region.

events.title: Carbon superhighway reimagines CO2 movement at scale
events.summary: ExxonMobil is developing a "carbon superhighway" along the Gulf Coast to address the limitations of traditional point-to-point carbon capture and storage (CCS) models. This integrated network connects multiple CO2 emitters to various storage sites and customers, offering greater flexibility for captured CO2 to be directed to permanent storage, enhanced oil recovery, or industrial uses. The system is designed to expand easily as new projects are added, allowing for efficient and scalable CO2 management.

events.title: TGS tiene ocho meses para terminar la ampliación del Gasoducto Perito Moreno
events.summary: Transportadora de Gas del Sur (TGS) has been given an eight-month deadline, until April 1, 2027, to complete the expansion of the Perito Moreno Gas Pipeline. This project aims to increase gas transportation capacity from Vaca Muerta by 14 million cubic meters daily, reaching a total of 35 million, and is expected to save Argentina up to US$700 million annually in energy imports. The expansion involves a US$800 million investment to install three compressor plants and reinforce the existing TGS system, primarily to meet winter demand and reduce reliance on imported natural gas and liquid fuels.

events.title: Petrobras Profit Tops Estimates
events.summary: Brazilian oil producer Petrobras exceeded second-quarter expectations with adjusted earnings of 93.8 billion reais ($18.4 billion), an 80% increase from the previous year. This performance was driven by higher crude, gasoline, and diesel prices due to US-Iran conflict-related supply disruptions. The company chose to reward investors with $3.4 billion in shareholder payouts, surpassing analyst forecasts, rather than focusing solely on debt reduction like some rivals.

events.title: State Street (STT) discloses 5% beneficial ownership in Exxon Mobil common stock
events.summary: State Street Corporation has disclosed a 5% beneficial ownership stake in Exxon Mobil common stock, totaling 207,041,423 shares, through a Schedule 13G filing. The filing indicates shared voting power over 142,192,919 shares and shared dispositive power over 206,811,526 shares, attributed to various State Street Global Advisors subsidiaries acting on behalf of clients. events.title: Halliburton (NYSE:HAL) stock in focus as geopolitical supply concerns lift oilfield services
events.summary: Halliburton (NYSE:HAL) shares recently rose due to heightened geopolitical supply concerns, which brought the oilfield services sector into focus. events.title: BP p.l.c. $BP Shares Purchased by Russell Investments Group Ltd.

events.title: ExxonMobil awards McDermott letter of intent for Rovuma LNG Phase 1 engineering and procurement work in Mozambique
events.summary: ExxonMobil Moçambique Limitada has awarded McDermott Energy Solutions (UK) Ltd. a letter of intent for engineering and procurement services for the Rovuma LNG Phase 1 midstream development in Mozambique. This step advances the project, building on McDermott's prior FEED services, as partners work toward a final investment decision expected in 2026. The Rovuma LNG project aims to produce 18.6 million metric tons per year of LNG, with a targeted start-up in 2031, positioning Mozambique as a major global LNG supplier.

events.title: High Dividend ETFs Are Beating the S&P 500 by 9 Points in 2026 and These 3 Pay Up to 4 Percent While Doing It
events.summary: This article highlights how high-dividend ETFs like HDV, FDL, and DTD are outperforming the S&P 500 in 2026, reversing a decade-long trend. It details each fund's approach, holdings, and dividend strategies, catering to different investor preferences. The outperformance is attributed to a rotation into defensive sectors amidst concerns about mega-cap concentration risk.

events.title: Chevron Hit Record U.S. Production, Cut Its Debt by $8 Billion, and Still Yields 3.6%. Is It the Better Oil Major Right Now?
events.summary: Chevron's Q2 2026 results showed significant benefits from its acquisition of Hess Corporation, leading to record U.S. production, substantial revenue growth, and early achievement of cost reduction targets. The company also aggressively paid down debt, reducing net debt-to-CFFO to 0.6 times. With a 3.6% dividend yield and a valuation of 13 times forward earnings, Chevron is positioned for accelerating free cash flow and offers a modest edge over ExxonMobil for investors seeking income and capital discipline.

events.title: Ecopetrol Wins Auction to Take Control of Brazil’s Brava Energia
events.summary: Ecopetrol has successfully acquired approximately 25% of Brava Energia S.A. through an auction on the B3 exchange, following a previous agreement to purchase 26% from existing shareholders. This combination will grant Ecopetrol a 51% controlling voting stake in the Brazilian oil and gas producer. The acquisition, which faced and overcame a temporary regulatory suspension, is a strategic move to expand Ecopetrol's international exploration and production portfolio and diversify its reserve base.

events.title: Exxon Mobil stock holds near $160 after Q2 earnings
events.summary: Exxon Mobil stock is trading near $160 following its Q2 2026 earnings report on July 31, 2026, which showed revenues of $114.53 billion and adjusted profit of $3.52 per share. Analyst sentiment remains mixed, with a consensus price target of $163.29, while Jefferies recently raised its target to $200.

events.title: The Bull Case For Core Natural Resources (CNR) Could Change Following Profit Return And Aggressive Buybacks – Learn Why
events.summary: Core Natural Resources (CNR) reported a significant turnaround in Q2 2026, moving from a net loss to a net income of US$126.47 million, with sales reaching US$1,141.01 million. The company also confirmed a US$0.10 quarterly dividend and completed a US$329.21 million share buyback. This return to profitability and continued shareholder distributions could influence CNR's investment narrative, though long-term risks related to climate policy and decarbonization persist.

events.title: Brent Crude Nears $89 As Hormuz Stays Disrupted – Exxon, Chevron And Shell Rack Up Record Cash Flow
events.summary: The top five international oil companies, including ExxonMobil, Chevron, and Shell, recorded almost $70 billion in free cash flow in Q2 2026, marking a new high driven by rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions. This record cash flow coincides with Brent crude nearing $89 per barrel due to the ongoing U.S.-Iran conflict and disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, while U.S. crude stockpiles have fallen to their lowest in over four decades. Despite the geopolitical instability, major oil stocks have seen significant climbs, although retail sentiment on Stocktwits remains largely bearish or neutral for many of these assets.

events.title: Brent Crude Nears $89 As Hormuz Stays Disrupted – Exxon, Chevron And Shell Rack Up Record Cash Flow
events.summary: Brent crude oil is approaching $89 per barrel amidst ongoing disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz and U.S.-Iran tensions. Major oil companies like ExxonMobil, Chevron, and Shell reported a record $70 billion in free cash flow in Q2 2026, surpassing previous peaks. Concurrently, the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve has fallen to its lowest level in over four decades, intensifying concerns about global oil supply.

events.title: Western Midstream Announces Participation in the Solitude Pipeline System
events.summary: Western Midstream Partners, LP (WES) has announced its participation in the Solitude Pipeline System joint venture, which has reached a Final Investment Decision to construct two 48-inch natural gas pipelines from the Permian Basin to Katy, Texas. WES holds a 7.5% equity interest in Solitude and has secured firm transportation capacity on the pipelines to provide incremental residue takeaway and enhanced flow assurance for its Delaware Basin customers. The project is expected to deliver an initial capacity of approximately 2.25 Bcf/d in late 2029, with an additional 2.25 Bcf/d in 2030, and further capacity increases possible.

events.title: Russell Investments Group Ltd. Has $83.88 Million Stock Position in Devon Energy Corporation $DVN
events.summary: Russell Investments Group Ltd. significantly increased its stake in Devon Energy Corporation by 45.9% in the second quarter, now holding over 2 million shares valued at $83.88 million. Other institutional investors also adjusted their positions in DVN. The article details Devon Energy's financial performance, including its recent earnings beat, dividend announcement, and updated analyst price targets.

events.title: Chevron discovers oil and gas offshore Angola
events.summary: Chevron Corporation announced an oil and gas condensate discovery at the 105-4X exploration well in Block 0, offshore Angola. The discovery, which encountered a column exceeding 600 meters in the Pinda reservoir, will be evaluated for development as a tie-back to existing facilities. This expands Chevron's exploration portfolio in Sub-Saharan Africa, where it currently produces around 300,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day.

events.title: Chevron Advances Its Strategic Exploration Program With Discovery in Angola's Block 0
events.summary: Chevron's subsidiary, Cabinda Gulf Oil Company Limited (CABGOC), announced a new oil and gas condensate discovery in Angola's Block 0. The 105-4X exploration well found over 600 meters of oil and gas condensate in the Pinda reservoir, with potential for tie-back development to existing facilities. This discovery reinforces Chevron's exploration strategy in Sub-Saharan Africa and its confidence in Angola's resource potential.

events.title: ONEOK stock trades near $95 as investors digest strong second quarter and upbeat targets
events.summary: ONEOK Inc. (OKE) stock is trading near $95 after a strong second quarter in 2026, driven by improved volumes and cash flow following the Magellan Midstream acquisition. Despite trading above the average analyst price target of $91.81, the company continues to attract institutional interest, supported by positive sector fundamentals and a constructive equity market. The midstream energy company's fee-based model, diversified assets, and capital discipline are highlighted as factors contributing to its current valuation.

events.title: PBR Q2 Earnings Beat on Record Production and Higher Brent
events.summary: Petrobras (PBR) reported strong Q2 2026 earnings, exceeding analyst estimates, driven by record oil, NGL, and natural gas production, increased exports, and higher Brent crude pricing. The company saw significant year-over-year revenue and profit growth across its Exploration & Production, Refining, Transportation and Marketing, and Gas and Low Carbon Energies segments. Petrobras's performance was also boosted by strong cash generation, supporting investments and debt reduction, despite an increase in operating expenses partly due to higher taxes.

events.title: PBR Q2 Earnings Beat on Record Production and Higher Brent
events.summary: Petroleo Brasileiro S.A. (Petrobras) reported a significant beat in its second-quarter 2026 earnings, with an ADS of $1.72, exceeding the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $1.52. This strong performance was driven by record production, increased exports, and higher Brent crude pricing, leading to a 59.8% year-over-year revenue jump to $33,607 million. The company's upstream, refining, and gas units all showed substantial gains, with robust cash flow supporting investments and debt reduction.

events.title: YPF-led Argentina LNG seeks approval for $51-billion investment
events.summary: YPF, Eni, and XRG have submitted their $51 billion Argentina LNG project for approval under Argentina’s Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI), aiming to develop Vaca Muerta natural gas for large-scale LNG exports. The project includes upstream gas production, pipelines, processing facilities, and two floating LNG units with a combined capacity of 12 MMtpa. This initiative is expected to generate approximately $10 billion annually in export revenue and create numerous jobs, making it a significant step for Argentina to become a global energy exporter.

events.title: PBR Q2 Earnings Beat on Record Production and Higher Brent
events.summary: Petrobras (PBR) reported strong second-quarter 2026 earnings, surpassing analyst estimates due to record production, increased exports, and higher Brent crude pricing. The company's earnings per ADS jumped 168.8% year-over-year, with revenues increasing by 59.8%. Both upstream exploration and production, and downstream refining segments saw significant gains, while the gas unit also improved profitability.

events.title: Empire reaches 21,006 feet in Western Haynesville re-entry in East Texas
events.summary: Empire Petroleum Corporation announced a significant milestone in its Texas gas development program, successfully re-entering and evaluating the Wakefield-Harrison GU B #1 well to 21,006 feet in Madison County. This achievement marks Empire as the first microcap energy company to reach such depths in the Western Haynesville play, utilizing a legacy wellbore for approximately $4.4 million, significantly less than the $30-45 million for new ultra-deep wells. The re-entry exposed 11,000 feet of previously untested formation with hydrocarbon shows, providing crucial data for future development and enhancing the understanding of the deep Cotton Valley, Bossier, and Haynesville intervals.

events.title: Perspective: Morning Commentary for August 17
events.summary: This morning commentary by Arlan Suderman discusses the impact of ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and Black Sea on commodity markets. It highlights Iran's threats to escalate regional conflict and Ukraine's continued strikes on Russian ports, both contributing to heightened risk and volatility in oil and grain prices. The article also provides an update on the Pro Farmer Midwest Crop Tour and its potential influence on grain market focus.

events.title: Exxon Shares Lifted by Iran Tensions, Consensus Upside Narrows to 3%
events.summary: Exxon Mobil (NYSE:XOM) shares rose 0.7% due to heightened Iran tensions and increased oil prices, with Brent crude nearing $89 per barrel. Despite the stock's rise, analysts project a modest 3.2% potential upside, indicating a narrowing consensus. The article highlights the impact of geopolitical events on oil markets and Exxon's robust financial performance, while noting the divided analyst sentiment regarding future valuation.

events.title: Empire Petroleum marks well re-entry in Western Haynesville
events.summary: Empire Petroleum Corporation successfully re-entered and evaluated the 21,006-ft. Wakefield-Harrison GU B #1 well in Texas, marking a significant step in its gas development program. This achievement, completed for approximately $4.4 million, establishes a foundation for their strategy to develop the Intermediate Production Zones and Deep Productive Zones in the Fort Trinidad Field. Empire is positioning itself to capitalize on global energy market opportunities by being the first microcap energy company to reach such depths with modern logging and core samples.

events.title: ExxonMobil awards $1.1 billion in contracts for Mozambique LNG
events.summary: ExxonMobil has awarded approximately $1.1 billion in pre-investment contracts for upstream equipment for its Rovuma LNG Phase 1 project in Mozambique. These contracts, issued on behalf of Area 4 partners, cover subsea production systems, large-bore production valves, and offshore line pipe, aiming to advance the project towards a final investment decision. This development follows ExxonMobil lifting force majeure on the project in November after operations were halted in 2021 due to security concerns.

events.title: NACo Legal Advocacy: Suncor Energy v. Boulder County
events.summary: NACo has joined an amicus brief in the Supreme Court case Suncor Energy v. Boulder County, arguing that federal law should not broadly preempt counties from pursuing state-law claims to recover costs from private parties. The case, which Boulder County brought against Suncor Energy and Exxon Mobil, concerns whether local governments can use state law to seek damages for climate-related harms and has broader implications for counties' ability to use state courts for various types of litigation. NACo emphasizes the importance of preserving counties' access to state courts to address local harms and recover costs.

events.title: Targa Resources stock rises on ExxonMobil midstream deal
events.summary: Targa Resources Corp. (NYSE:TRGP) shares rose after announcing new 20-year midstream agreements with ExxonMobil subsidiaries for integrated natural gas gathering, processing, and downstream services in the Permian Basin. To support these agreements, Targa will build three new natural gas processing plants and a 70-mile pipeline in the Permian Delaware, leading to an updated 2026 net growth capital estimate of approximately $5.0 billion.

events.title: Targa Resources Announces Expanded Long-Term Midstream Agreements with ExxonMobil in the Permian Basin
events.summary: Targa Resources Corp. has announced new 20-year midstream agreements with ExxonMobil, significantly expanding their partnership in the Permian Basin for natural gas gathering, processing, and NGL services. To support anticipated production growth, Targa plans to construct three new natural gas processing plants and a new 70-mile pipeline, increasing its 2026 growth capital estimate to approximately $5 billion. These agreements are expected to drive substantial long-term volume growth and enhance Targa's adjusted free cash flow.

events.title: YPF (NYSE: YPF) more than doubles cash flow, expands Vaca Muerta stake
events.summary: YPF S.A. reported a significant increase in its H1 2026 net profit to $1.614 billion on sales of $11.520 billion, demonstrating strong financial recovery and cash generation, with operating cash flow more than doubling to $4.237 billion. The company also expanded its interests in the Vaca Muerta-related blocks, Bandurria Sur and Bajo del Toro, through strategic acquisitions. YPF continues its upstream portfolio optimization plan, classifying some mature assets for sale while addressing regulatory approvals and contractual conditions for completed and pending transactions.

events.title: ExxonMobil's Targa deal includes 3 new gas plants—when will they operate?
events.summary: Targa Resources announced new 20-year, fee-based integrated midstream agreements with ExxonMobil subsidiaries for natural gas gathering, processing, and NGL transportation and fractionation across the Permian Delaware and Permian Midland. To support anticipated volume growth, Targa plans to build three new Permian Delaware processing plants (Wrangler, Ranger, and Ranger II) with a combined capacity of approximately 825 MMcf/d, and a new 70-mile Bull Run II natural gas pipeline, all targeted for service in the first half of 2028. The company also updated its full-year 2026 net growth capital estimate to about $5.0 billion to reflect these new projects.

events.title: Targa Resources Corp. Announces 20-Year Agreements with ExxonMobil and Announces Three New Natural Gas Processing Plants in the Permian Delaware
events.summary: Targa Resources Corp. announced 20-year agreements with ExxonMobil for integrated natural gas gathering and processing and downstream services in the Permian Basin, covering significant acreage dedications in both the Delaware and Midland basins. To support this expanded partnership and anticipated growth, Targa will construct three new natural gas processing plants and a new 70-mile pipeline in the Permian Delaware, and is evaluating up to five additional plants. These developments enhance Targa's strategic relationship with ExxonMobil and project long-term volume growth and durable free cash flow.

events.title: Oil prices raise drilling potential as Permianville holds $2.0M reserve
events.summary: Permianville Royalty Trust (NYSE: PVL) announced a cash distribution of $0.027000 per unit, payable on September 15, 2026. events.title: Esab stock hits 52-week low at 82.15 USD By Investing.com

events.title: ExxonMobil awards contracts worth about 1.1 US billion dollars

events.title: CVX Stock Rises Overnight: Chevron Says It Has Discovered Oil, Gas Condensate Offshore In Angola

events.title: Targa Signs 20-Year ExxonMobil Deals, Adds 825 MMcf/d Capacity

events.title: Key facts: BP PLC (BP.) markets £2.5bn North Sea hubs; buys E5 barges

events.title: ExxonMobil commits $1.1 billion before final approval of its $30 billion Mozambique LNG project

events.title: Jefferies Adjusts Price Target on Targa Resources to $345 From $324, Keeps Buy Rating

The article also mentions other recent analyst price target changes and Targa's recent long-term agreements with ExxonMobil and plans for new Permian gas plants.

events.title: Exxon shares climb 1.5% as Brent at $91 challenges Vance’s lower-oil target
events.summary: Exxon Mobil (NYSE:XOM) shares rose 1.5% as Brent crude hit $91.22, significantly above Vice President JD Vance's target of $79. events.title: Ten numbers behind YPF's record quarter under Marin's 4X4 plan
events.summary: YPF, under Horacio Marín's 4x4 strategic plan, reported a record quarter in 2026, bouncing back from a significant annual loss in 2023. The fourth pillar, Argentina LNG, is still in the capital outflow phase but is central to future growth, with other key metrics like lifting costs, leverage, and downstream utilization also showing significant improvement.

events.title: Ecopetrol takes control of Brava Energia, debuts in Brazilian production
events.summary: Colombia's Ecopetrol has acquired control of Brazilian firm Brava Energia, marking its entry into Brazilian oil and gas production and expanding its exploration portfolio. The acquisition, conducted through a public tender offer and private share acquisition, gives Ecopetrol approximately 51% of Brava Energia's capital. Brava Energia is a significant producer in Brazil, with operations in key offshore and onshore fields and an exploration portfolio including blocks in promising new frontier basins.

events.title: Empire Petroleum’s Fort Trinidad midstream positions Western Haynesville gas for market
events.summary: Empire Petroleum is advancing its deep-gas development program in the Western Haynesville play by leveraging its Fort Trinidad midstream infrastructure, including 49 miles of pipeline and significant compression capacity. (DSX) has withdrawn its nearly year-long takeover bid for Genco Shipping & Trading Limited (GNK), stating Genco's demands were unrealistic for any credible acquirer. This ends a protracted fight in the shipping industry, leaving Diana as Genco's largest shareholder. Genco's shares fell slightly on the news, as the company now needs to justify its valuation without the takeover premium.

events.title: Cost to Ship a VLCC Through Hormuz Hits $20 Million, TotalEnergies CEO Says
events.summary: TotalEnergies CEO Patrick Pouyanne stated that shipping oil on a supertanker through the Strait of Hormuz costs around $20 million, translating to about $10 a barrel. This high freight cost creates significant profit margins for traders and shipowners, as producers sell oil inside the Persian Gulf at $50-$60 per barrel due to ongoing conflict. Despite fears of price surges, increased oil flows through Hormuz have kept benchmark Brent futures below $100, while fuel markets remain tight due to attacks on Russian refineries.

events.title: $20 million: The cost of shipping oil through Strait of Hormuz, TotalEnergies CEO says
events.summary: The CEO of TotalEnergies, Patrick Pouyanne, revealed that shipping oil through the Strait of Hormuz now costs $20 million per supertanker. This high cost creates significant margins for traders and shipowners, but Middle Eastern producers are offering sharp discounts on crude to maintain market access. While these shipments keep global crude prices below $100, the fuel markets remain tight due to increased transportation costs for refined products and attacks on Russian refineries.

events.title: ExxonMobil vs. Chevron: We Compared 10 Years of Dividend Growth And Here’s the Winner
events.summary: This article compares the dividend growth of ExxonMobil (XOM) and Chevron (CVX) over the past decade, highlighting their differing strategies and dividend durability. While ExxonMobil boasts a longer streak of consecutive annual dividend increases, Chevron offers a higher current yield and is exploring new revenue streams through a deal with Microsoft. The author ultimately leans towards ExxonMobil for dividend durability but acknowledges Chevron's appeal for higher current income.

events.title: ExxonMobil vs. Chevron: We Compared 10 Years of Dividend Growth And Here's the Winner
events.summary: This article compares the dividend growth of ExxonMobil (XOM) and Chevron (CVX) over the past decade, highlighting their differing strategies. While ExxonMobil boasts a longer streak of consecutive dividend increases due to organic growth, Chevron offers a higher current yield and is diversifying its revenue through a significant deal with Microsoft for AI data centers. The author leans towards ExxonMobil for dividend durability but finds Chevron more interesting for current income and optionality.

events.title: Resilient Exxon Mobil stock holds near highs as Guyana fire and Permian automation reshape the outlook
events.summary: Exxon Mobil's stock is trading near its recent highs despite a temporary halt in Guyana offshore operations due to a fire. The company's strong Q2 2026 earnings and a strategic push for automated drilling in the Permian Basin are bolstering investor confidence. Analysts see modest upside, balancing short-term risks with long-term earnings potential and efficiency gains.

events.title: Is Lucid Group (NASDAQ:LCID) Catching the Late-Week Electric-Vehicle Bounce?
events.summary: Lucid Group (NASDAQ:LCID) experienced a rebound late in the week as broader market sentiment for electric vehicles improved, driven by expectations of easier interest rates. The company, known for its luxury, long-range EVs and advanced battery technology, is focused on scaling production of its new sport-utility vehicle and exploring technology supply avenues. Despite facing industry challenges common to new manufacturers, Lucid's strong engineering, premium positioning, and substantial financial backing provide a distinctive path in the competitive luxury EV market.

events.title: Exxon Mobil Guyana receives Errea Wittu FPSO at Uaru field
events.summary: ExxonMobil Guyana has received the Errea Wittu FPSO, delivered by MODEC Inc., for deployment in the Stabroek block offshore Guyana. This advanced FPSO is designed to produce 250,000 b/d of oil and process 540 MMcfd of gas, integrating resources from the Snoek, Mako, and Uaru fields. It features AI-enabled systems for predicting equipment failures, reducing emissions, and enhancing safety, and will undergo final preparations before first oil.

events.title: Freeport-McMoRan Diversifies Your Return, Not Your Risk
events.summary: Freeport-McMoRan (FCX) stock offers a unique return stream that partially diversifies a portfolio due to its correlation with the S&P 500 being in the middle of the range, meaning it takes some market direction but also has its own. The company's supply story, particularly from its Grasberg mine, provides a distinct driver for its performance, independent of broader market movements. However, investors should be prepared for significant volatility, as FCX stock tends to move more than twice as much as the market in either direction.

events.title: ICYMI - Morgan Stanley lifts Brent forecast to $100 as oil market tightens
events.summary: Morgan Stanley has significantly increased its Brent crude forecasts, anticipating a peak of $100 in Q4 2026 due to a slower-than-expected recovery in Middle East supply and tightening market conditions. The bank's strategist, Mike Wilson, also identified a renewed oil spike as the biggest risk to US stocks, recommending energy shares as a portfolio hedge. The upgraded outlook reflects falling oil inventories and a wide gap between crude and refined product prices, indicating constrained refining capacity.

events.title: Root Inc. CFO Ryan Forish Reports RSU Tax Withholding via Share Disposition
events.summary: Ryan Forish, Chief Accounting Officer of Root, Inc. (NASDAQ:ROOT), reported a disposition of 88 shares of Class A Common Stock on August 21, 2026. These shares, valued at $55.79 each, were withheld by the issuer to cover tax obligations stemming from restricted stock units vesting. Following this transaction, Forish directly holds 24,228 shares of Class A Common Stock.

events.title: ExxonMobil and Area 4 partners award $1.1 billion in contracts for Mozambique's Rovuma LNG project ahead of final investment decision
events.summary: ExxonMobil and its Area 4 partners have awarded approximately $1.1 billion in engineering, procurement, and manufacturing contracts for the Rovuma LNG project in Mozambique, even before a final investment decision (FID). This strategic move aims to optimize project timelines and ensure the availability of critical infrastructure for the planned onshore liquefaction facility, which will process offshore gas at 18.6 million metric tons per year. The largest contract went to OneSubsea for subsea production systems, and other significant awards were made for pipes and valves, with a target FID in 2026.

events.title: 3rd Circ. Revives Exxon Unit's Bid To Arbitrate Royalties Claims
events.summary: The Third Circuit has ruled that ExxonMobil subsidiary XTO Energy Inc. will get another opportunity to pursue arbitration in a case involving allegedly underpaid natural gas royalties. The court determined that litigating class claims for over four years did not prevent XTO Energy from seeking an out-of-court resolution. This decision allows the Exxon unit to re-engage in arbitration despite previous litigation.

events.title: Empire Petroleum completes deepest modern subsurface evaluation in Western Haynesville play at 21,006 feet for $4.4 million by re-entering a 1959 wellbore
events.summary: Empire Petroleum Corporation successfully completed the deepest modern subsurface evaluation in the Western Haynesville play, reaching 21,006 feet by re-entering a 1959 wellbore for $4.4 million. This cost-effective approach is significantly cheaper than the $30-$45 million other operators spend on new ultra-deep wells. The evaluation provided critical data, including hydrocarbon shows and core samples, which will inform Empire's two-zone development strategy across its IPZ and DPZ targets.

events.title: Resilient Exxon Mobil stock trades close to highs as Q2 2026 cash flow and Guyana project drive the
events.summary: Exxon Mobil stock is trading near its recent highs, driven by strong Q2 2026 earnings, robust cash generation, and promising long-term projects in Guyana and advanced products. Despite a slight earnings miss and short-term operational disruptions, investor confidence remains high, focusing on the company's overall profitability and cash flow. The stock's performance and valuation reflect strong year-to-date gains, with analysts closely watching future growth in both upstream and specialty product segments.

events.title: Southern Energy Corp. Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results and Information Regarding the Annual Meeting of Shareholders
events.summary: Southern Energy Corp. announced its second-quarter 2026 financial and operating results, reporting petroleum and natural gas sales of $4.2 million and a net loss of $0.4 million. The company achieved an average production of 10,460 Mcfe/d, a 7% decrease from the previous year due to a transportation dispute. Southern spudded a new Cotton Valley test well and plans to complete a drilled but uncompleted well, maintaining financial flexibility after retiring its senior secured credit facility.

events.title: Zacks Market Edge Highlights: ExxonMobil, TotalEnergies, Chevron
events.summary: Zacks Market Edge podcast host Tracey Ryniec discusses the investment opportunities in "Big Oil" companies like ExxonMobil, TotalEnergies, and Chevron, especially in the context of the ongoing Iran War. The article highlights how these integrated energy companies have generated massive free cash flows due to elevated refining margins, exacerbated by drone strikes on Russian refineries. It recommends these three companies as "buys" based on their financial performance, shareholder-friendly policies, and attractive valuations.

events.title: Elevation Point Wealth Partners LLC Sells 7,467 Shares of EOG Resources, Inc. $EOG
events.summary: Elevation Point Wealth Partners LLC has reduced its stake in EOG Resources, Inc. by 51.8% during the second quarter, selling 7,467 shares and retaining 6,955 shares valued at approximately $902,000. Other institutional investors like Sivia Capital Partners LLC and Quantbot Technologies LP bought new stakes, while Gamco Investors INC. ET AL and Sei Investments Co. increased their holdings. EOG Resources reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst estimates, and declared a $1.02 quarterly dividend, yet analyst sentiment remains mixed with a consensus "Hold" rating.

events.title: OMERS ADMINISTRATION Corp Invests $8.29 Million in Marathon Petroleum Corporation $MPC
events.summary: OMERS ADMINISTRATION Corp recently acquired a new stake of 32,429 shares in Marathon Petroleum Corporation, valued at approximately $8.29 million during the second quarter. Other institutional investors have also adjusted their holdings, while company insiders have sold shares totaling over $8.7 million in the last 90 days. Marathon Petroleum currently holds a "Moderate Buy" rating from analysts with a consensus target price of $312.50.

events.title: Zacks Market Edge Highlights: ExxonMobil, TotalEnergies, Chevron
events.summary: This article from Zacks Market Edge, hosted by Tracey Ryniec, discusses investment opportunities in "Big Oil" companies like ExxonMobil, Chevron, and TotalEnergies, especially in the context of the Iran War's impact on the energy sector. It highlights their record free cash flow in Q2 2026 due to elevated refining margins, even as oil prices remain under $100 per barrel. The article recommends these three companies as top picks, emphasizing their integrated operations, strong financial performance, and shareholder-friendly practices.

events.title: NuRAN Wireless files shelf prospectus for future offerings By Investing.com
events.summary: NuRAN Wireless Inc. has filed a short form base shelf prospectus and a corresponding registration statement, enabling future offerings of securities. This strategic move aims to finance the construction and commissioning of over 2,000 telecommunications infrastructure sites and support operational expenditures for its deployment program. The filing is a key part of NuRAN's North American capital markets strategy, including its Nasdaq listing, though no securities are being offered at this time.

events.title: Tuniu reports Q2 results, shares dip slightly on weak guidance By Investing.com
events.summary: Tuniu Corporation reported Q2 financial results, with revenue increasing 3.0% year-over-year to RMB138.9 million ($20.5 million) and adjusted earnings per ADS of RMB0.07 ($0.01). Despite achieving its sixth consecutive quarter of adjusted profitability, shares dipped slightly due to weak Q3 revenue guidance, which implies growth of 0% to 5% YoY. The company's focus remains on expanding product offerings and strengthening its sales channels.

events.title: Zacks Market Edge Highlights: ExxonMobil, TotalEnergies, Chevron
events.summary: This Zacks Market Edge podcast episode discusses investing in "Big Oil" companies like ExxonMobil, TotalEnergies, and Chevron, particularly six months into the Iran War. The article highlights how these integrated energy companies have generated significant free cash flow due to elevated refining margins, especially after drone strikes impacted Russian refineries. It recommends these three companies as potential buys due to strong financial performance, attractive valuations, and shareholder-friendly policies.

events.title: Webs Creek Capital Management LP Buys New Stake in Expro Group Holdings N.V. $XPRO
events.summary: Webs Creek Capital Management LP has acquired a new stake in Expro Group Holdings N.V. (NYSE:XPRO), purchasing over 2.83 million shares valued at approximately $41.7 billion, making it their 6th largest holding. This acquisition represents about 2.52% of Expro Group and 7.9% of Webs Creek Capital Management's total holdings. Expro Group recently reported mixed quarterly results, with revenue exceeding estimates but earnings per share falling short, and institutional investors now collectively own 92.07% of the company's stock.

events.title: JPMorgan, Santander lead financing of up to US$15 billion for LNG Project
events.summary: JPMorgan Chase and Banco Santander are leading the financing efforts for the Argentina LNG project, aiming to secure US$14 billion to US$15 billion of the total US$24 billion cost. This unprecedented project, a venture between YPF SA, Eni SpA, and XRG, seeks to liquefy and export Argentina's shale gas, with a final investment decision expected in late November. The initiative highlights a revival in Argentina's energy sector under President Javier Milei's free-market reforms.

events.title: Callan JMB Designates Andy Weigman to Join Callan Power's Oil and Gas Development Efforts; Weigman Brings Experience on More Than $1 Billion in Sourced Acquisition Opportunities and Extensive Williston Basin Operational Expertise
events.summary: Callan JMB announced that Andy Weigman will join Callan Power as Senior Vice President of Land and Acquisitions, reinforcing its oil and gas development efforts. Weigman, bringing 14 years of Williston Basin experience and expertise in sourcing over $1 billion in acquisitions, will reunite with Callan Power President Mike Reger to build a non-operated oil and gas well portfolio. This appointment underscores Callan JMB's strategy to create a scalable non-operated acquisition platform in the energy sector.

events.title: Vivakor raises 2026 crude oil marketing outlook to $3.5 billion
events.summary: Vivakor Inc. has increased its 2026 Supply & Trading outlook to $3.5 billion in annualized commercial activity, up from its current level of $2.35 billion. This revised forecast is driven by the expansion of its commercial pipeline and dynamic global crude oil market conditions, including heightened activity during geopolitical volatility in the Middle East. The company aims for continued growth through increased physical crude oil volumes and expanded commercial relationships, while noting that its gross profit will be a small percentage of the total contract value.

events.title: Richtech Robotics Announces $12 Million Stock Repurchase Plan and Executive Healthcare Stipends
events.summary: Richtech Robotics Inc. has announced a board-approved stock repurchase program of up to $12 million for its Class B common stock, effective until August 21, 2027. Additionally, the company's compensation committee approved bi-weekly healthcare cash stipends of $750 for its CEO, CFO, and COO, totaling approximately $19,500 annually. Both initiatives took effect on August 21, 2026.

events.title: Shell's $8B Chemicals Exit Signals a Sharper Oil and Gas Focus
events.summary: Shell is reportedly looking to divest its U.S. chemicals assets, potentially worth up to $8 billion, to refocus on its core oil and gas business. This move is part of a broader strategy by CEO Wael Sawan to streamline its portfolio, reduce costs, and prioritize investments with stronger strategic potential and higher returns. Major industry players like ExxonMobil and LyondellBasell, along with private equity firms, have expressed interest in the assets.

events.title: Levi Strauss & Co., Ford, ExxonMobil, PSEG, eBay Named Among Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Companies 2026
events.summary: Newsweek has released its second annual "America's Greatest Companies 2026" ranking, recognizing 650 leading U.S. publicly listed companies. The ranking, developed with Plant-A Insights Group, evaluates companies on financial strength, employer performance, innovation, and environmental sustainability. Companies like Levi Strauss & Co., Ford, ExxonMobil, PSEG, and eBay received five-star recognition for demonstrating resilience, responsible leadership, investment in their workforces, and commitment to sustainable growth.

events.title: Brazil approves LNG joint venture between YPF, Eni and XRG
events.summary: Brazil's antitrust authority, Cade, has approved a joint venture between Argentina’s YPF, Eni Argentina, and XRG (a subsidiary of ADNOC) for a large-scale integrated liquefied natural gas (LNG) project in Argentina. The project will involve dedicated upstream production, pipeline transportation, and offshore liquefaction using two floating liquefaction units (FLNGs) off the coast of Sierra Grande, with the first unit expected to begin operations in 2030. Cade's approval was granted after assessing the companies' operations in Brazil and determining that their market shares were below thresholds that would indicate a dominant position or risk of market foreclosure.

events.title: XOM vs EPD: Which Stock Offers the Better Growth Opportunity?
events.summary: This article compares ExxonMobil (XOM) and Enterprise Products Partners (EPD), two energy sector companies with different business models, to determine which offers better growth potential. XOM, an integrated energy company, is favored due to high crude prices, constrained refining capacity, and production growth from advantaged assets, despite its sensitivity to commodity prices. EPD, a midstream operator, provides more stable, fee-based cash flows but may not capitalize as much on current market volatility, although it has significant growth projects under construction.

events.title: Woodside Retreats on Clean Energy, Doubles Down on LNG
events.summary: Australia's largest oil and gas producer, Woodside Energy Group Ltd., is scaling back its clean energy investments and emissions-abatement targets to prioritize fossil fuels. The company cites a "change in customer appetite" and delays in policy frameworks as reasons for its shift, which includes abandoning a $5 billion clean-energy spending plan by 2030. This strategic pivot comes as Woodside reports increased earnings due to higher oil and LNG prices, despite a drop in production.

events.title: Targa Resources Slides as Leadership Change Meets Broader Energy Weakness
events.summary: Targa Resources (TRGP) shares dropped 4.4% due to a combination of leadership changes and a broader decline in energy prices. The company announced a CFO transition and other executive appointments, which coincided with a sharp fall in crude oil prices. This market reaction occurred despite Targa's recent positive news, including expanded agreements and record Q2 results.

events.title: Morgan Stanley Sees ExxonMobil (XOM) Breaking its Record High. Can the Oil Giant Deliver?
events.summary: Morgan Stanley has raised its price target for ExxonMobil (XOM) to $177, predicting the stock will surpass its previous record high due to strong refining margins and growth in areas like the Permian Basin and LNG. Despite falling short of Q2 earnings expectations, ExxonMobil demonstrated strong fundamentals with significant free cash flow, debt reduction, and a commitment to shareholder returns. However, the company faces geopolitical risks and potential normalization of oil prices if peace agreements are reached in the Middle East.

events.title: Forum Energy Technologies at Midwest IDEAS: growth, cash and value
events.summary: Forum Energy Technologies (FET) presented at the 17th Annual Midwest IDEAS Conference, highlighting its strong financial performance, compelling valuation, and strategic growth plans. The company detailed significant revenue and EBITDA increases, consistent cash generation, and a capital allocation strategy focused on share repurchases and debt reduction. FET aims to double revenue, quadruple EBITDA, and triple free cash flow by 2030 through organic market share gains and expanding into new markets like data center heat transfer units.

events.title: ExxonMobil Set to Raise Dividend for 44th Consecutive Year
events.summary: ExxonMobil is anticipated to announce its 44th consecutive dividend increase, likely alongside its Q3 results, despite recent annual increases being modest at around 4%. The company demonstrates strong financial health with $14.5 billion in Q2 net income and robust cash flow, which covers its current $1.03 quarterly dividend nearly four times. ExxonMobil balances dividend payouts with significant investments in share repurchases and capital expenditures, while also strategically pursuing growth through acquisitions and expansion into lower-carbon businesses like its Proxxima resin systems.

events.title: Morgan Stanley Sees ExxonMobil (XOM) Breaking its Record High. Can the Oil Giant Deliver?
events.summary: Morgan Stanley has increased its price target for ExxonMobil (XOM) to $177, maintaining an 'Overweight' rating, and expects the stock to surpass its previous record high. The firm's bullish outlook is based on updated energy sector forecasts, strong refining margins, and ExxonMobil's solid business fundamentals, including high upstream production and significant free cash flow generation. Despite strong performance, Exxon's gains have lagged pure-play refiners, and its earnings face geopolitical risks, particularly from potential normalization of crude prices and disruptions in the Middle East.

events.title: Targa Resources signs 20-year Permian Basin midstream deal with ExxonMobil, raises 2026 capital estimate to $5 billion
events.summary: Targa Resources has secured a 20-year, fee-based midstream agreement with ExxonMobil for natural gas gathering, processing, and NGL transportation across the Permian Basin's Delaware and Midland sub-basins. To support this growth, Targa will build three new processing plants and a 70-mile pipeline, leading to a revised 2026 growth capital estimate of $5 billion. This long-term partnership reinforces Targa's position as a key midstream operator in the Permian and provides ExxonMobil with essential infrastructure for its increasing production.

events.title: Exxon Mobil stock eases as oil slide tests record-high ambitions
events.summary: Exxon Mobil's stock is easing into the low $160s as a recent slide in crude oil prices offsets strong Q2 2026 cash flow. While the company generated $17.2 billion in free cash flow and returned $9.4 billion to shareholders, the drop in Brent and WTI crude has led to a 2.09% decline in its share price. Analysts have mixed views, with a consensus target around $166.10, but some bullish forecasts anticipate new record highs if favorable conditions persist.

events.title: Elizabeth Warren Slams Trump for ‘Holding Millions’ in Oil and Gas Stocks as Iran War Sends XOM, COP, OXY Higher
events.summary: Senator Elizabeth Warren criticized former President Donald Trump, alleging he profited from the Iran war by holding significant investments in oil and gas companies. Warren claimed Trump's holdings in companies like ExxonMobil, Chevron, ConocoPhillips, and Occidental Petroleum increased in value by millions after the conflict began. A Senate Joint Economic Committee report supported these claims, indicating Trump's oil and gas stock portfolio grew by an average of 39% from January to August.

events.title: VESSEL REVIEW | Aristoklis – Dual-fuel Suezmax crude tanker joins Capital Maritime fleet
events.summary: The Capital Maritime Group's business unit, Capital Clean Energy Carriers Corporation, has taken delivery of the dual-fuel Suezmax crude oil tanker "Aristoklis" from New Times Shipbuilding in China. This vessel, designed for reduced emissions, is powered by a Hyundai-MAN B&W dual-fuel engine capable of running on LNG and features an exhaust gas aftertreatment system. It also includes shore power connection capability, meeting California Air Resources Board requirements for integration with onshore power infrastructure at the Port of Long Beach.

events.title: Quantbot Technologies LP Acquires New Position in EOG Resources, Inc. $EOG
events.summary: Quantbot Technologies LP has acquired a new position in EOG Resources, Inc., purchasing 8,899 shares valued at approximately $1,154,000 in the second quarter. Other institutional investors like Varma Mutual Pension Insurance Co, X Square Capital LLC, Westpac Banking Corp, EP Wealth Advisors LLC, and Ieq Capital LLC also adjusted their holdings in the energy exploration company. EOG Resources recently reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst estimates, and announced a quarterly dividend of $1.02 per share.

events.title: ExxonMobil CFO Neil Hansen Set for Sept. 9 New York Webcast
events.summary: ExxonMobil's Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, Neil Hansen, will participate in a fireside chat at the Barclays 40th Annual Energy-Power Conference in New York on September 9, 2026. The event is scheduled for 8:00 a.m. ET and will be accessible via a live webcast, with an archived audio version available later on the ExxonMobil website. The announcement highlights ExxonMobil's commitment to improving quality of life and meeting societal needs through its diverse energy and petrochemical businesses.

events.title: ExxonMobil to Speak at Barclays 40th Annual Energy-Power Conference
events.summary: ExxonMobil announced that Neil Hansen, Senior Vice President and CFO, will participate in a fireside chat at the Barclays 40th Annual Energy-Power Conference on September 9, 2026, in New York. The event will be webcast live, and an archived audio version will be available later on the ExxonMobil website. The company also highlighted its operations and commitment to reducing greenhouse gas emissions.

events.title: Exxon Mobil stock holds in the low $160s as Guyana output and dividend strength shape the outlook
events.summary: Exxon Mobil stock is trading in the low $160s, supported by strong Q2 2026 earnings of $14.5 billion and operating cash flow of $23.6 billion. The company's investment appeal is strengthened by its growing free cash flow from Guyana, which reached 900,000 barrels per day in Q2 2026 and has recovered $55 billion in investment, alongside a 43-year track record of dividend increases. Despite recent oil price volatility, analysts maintain a "Hold" rating with an average target price of $166.10, recognizing the stock's year-to-date gain of 36.15%.

events.title: Assisted by Halliburton, Two Startups Slash Costs of Critical Minerals Refining
events.summary: Halliburton Labs, a subsidiary of Halliburton Company, is collaborating with two startups, Electroflow Technologies and SiTration Inc., to significantly reduce the costs and processing steps for critical minerals. Electroflow has developed a three-step process for extracting and refining lithium from brines, while SiTration offers a single-step method for recovering copper from mining waste streams. This initiative highlights the oil industry's increasing diversification into critical minerals, driven by energy security concerns and shifting political incentives.

events.title: Sempra Seeks Permits for Major LNG Expansion Project in Texas
events.summary: Sempra's unit, Port Arthur LNG, has initiated the federal permitting process for a significant expansion of its LNG export operations in Southeast Texas. The proposed Port Arthur LNG North Project aims to add four liquefaction trains, increasing capacity by up to 27 million metric tons per annum, and includes new storage tanks and marine facilities. If approved, the project could begin exporting LNG by the second half of 2034, further solidifying the U.S. Gulf Coast's role as a major global LNG exporter.

events.title: Canadian Oil Executives’ Stock Holdings Increased by Over $1 Billion Amid War and Wildfires
events.summary: A DeSmog analysis reveals that executives at Canadian Natural Resources Limited, Suncor, and Imperial Oil saw their personal stock holdings and options increase by over $1 billion from January to August 2026. This surge in wealth occurred during a period of rising global oil prices due to the ongoing war in Iran and devastating wildfires in Canada. The article highlights the disparity between executive windfalls and the struggles of average Canadians facing high gas prices and climate impacts, raising concerns about the oil industry's influence on government policy.

events.title: Sempra Plans 27 Million ton/yr Port Arthur LNG Expansion
events.summary: Sempra Infrastructure announced plans for a significant third phase expansion of its Port Arthur LNG export project. This expansion aims to add 27 million tons per year of capacity along the US Gulf Coast. The company targets completion of this massive project by the mid-2030s.

events.title: Palo Duro Investment Partners LP Takes Position in Targa Resources, Inc. $TRGP
events.summary: Palo Duro Investment Partners LP has acquired a new stake of 17,565 shares in Targa Resources, Inc. (NYSE:TRGP) valued at approximately $4.7 million, making it 0.9% of their portfolio. The stock is largely owned by institutional investors and hedge funds (92.13%), and analysts maintain a "Buy" rating with a consensus price target of $297.18. Despite strong Q2 EPS performance and positive analyst sentiment, the company faces potential concerns regarding recent insider share sales and a high debt-to-equity ratio of 5.0.

events.title: Occidental Petroleum (OXY) Earnings History & Trends
events.summary: This article provides a detailed overview of Occidental Petroleum's (OXY) earnings history and trends, including EPS and revenue performance against Street estimates. It highlights OXY's consistent EPS beat rate, average EPS surprise, and consecutive EPS beats, along with quarterly breakdowns of estimated and actual earnings and revenue figures. The report also includes data on OXY's 30-day return after each earnings report compared to the S&P 500.

events.title: CVX, HAL Stocks Gain — Chevron, Halliburton Reportedly Eye Venezuela Oil Opportunities
events.summary: Chevron and Halliburton are reportedly pursuing significant oil opportunities in Venezuela, with Chevron looking to add two heavy-oil fields and Halliburton discussing providing equipment to Venezuelan producers. This comes as the Trump administration negotiates a substantial stake in Venezuela's oil fields, potentially involving leases of up to 100 years, aiming to rebuild the country's oil industry following a change in its political leadership. CVX and HAL stocks saw gains on the news, with retail sentiment on Stocktwits showing mixed reactions.

events.title: Chevron nears deal to expand oil operations in Venezuela
events.summary: Chevron is reportedly in advanced talks to expand its oil operations in Venezuela by adding two new oil fields. This move comes as the Trump administration seeks to broaden its influence over Venezuela's oil sector, and other U.S. energy companies, including Halliburton, are also exploring investment opportunities in the country. Chevron is currently the only U.S. oil major active in Venezuela and accounts for about a fifth of its oil production.

events.title: Chevron in Talks to Expand in Venezuela Amid Broader US Push
events.summary: Chevron Corp. is reportedly in negotiations to expand its operations in Venezuela by adding two new oil fields, as the US aims to strengthen its presence in the country's oil industry. This move comes after a change in Venezuelan leadership facilitated by the Trump administration, which is pushing for US companies to rebuild the nation's oil sector. While Venezuela possesses vast oil reserves, significant challenges such as degraded infrastructure and environmental liabilities could delay a full recovery of production.

events.title: Exxon Mobil (XOM) Earnings History & Trends
events.summary: This article provides an overview of Exxon Mobil's (XOM) earnings history and trends, detailing its EPS and revenue performance against Street estimates. It highlights a 100% EPS beat rate with an average surprise of +5.12%, along with quarter-by-quarter financial data and stock performance post-earnings.

events.title: Chevron and Halliburton are nearing billion-dollar deals to invest in Venezuelan oil
events.summary: Chevron and Halliburton are reportedly close to signing multi-billion dollar deals to invest in Venezuelan oil fields. These agreements would mark a significant diplomatic and energy win for the Trump administration and potentially boost Venezuela's oil production, which holds some of the world's largest proven reserves. Energy Secretary Chris Wright is expected to attend the deal signings in Caracas next week, while other major oil companies like ExxonMobil and ConocoPhillips are holding off due to unresolved nationalization claims.

events.title: Royal London Asset Management Ltd. Increases Stake in Devon Energy Corporation $DVN
events.summary: Royal London Asset Management Ltd. significantly increased its holdings in Devon Energy Corporation by 520.1% in the second quarter, bringing its total stake to approximately 1.68 million shares valued at $69.6 million. This increase comes as Devon Energy reported strong quarterly earnings, exceeding analyst expectations with $1.57 EPS and $7.42 billion in revenue, and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.32 per share. Despite some recent price target reductions, analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for the company with an average price target of $59.15.

events.title: THE INHERITANCE: New ConocoPhillips CEO Inherits $7 Billion Cash Flow Pledge Riding on Alaska Oil Project
events.summary: Andy O’Brien is set to take over as CEO of ConocoPhillips next month, inheriting the crucial task of completing the Willow oil project in Alaska. This project is central to the company's goal of achieving $7 billion in free cash flow growth by 2029, a plan that O'Brien has affirmed as his top priority.
